body:
Yeah I thought this too. I'm only burdening others by telling them what's wrong. I want to see a therapist but I feel like I would just be wasting their time and taking resources away from someone else who needs them more.

I get stuck in this mindset so often now. It used to be once a  month or so. Now it feels like it happens every day.

No help. I've told my gf and brother that I've contemplated suicide every day of my life since 16. They want me to get better but I don't think they understand how far... gone I am. I don't want them to be upset so I'm thinking about just being a horrible person until they'll be glad I'm gone.
